items.topic: For the offline-first architecture, should the local database (IndexedDB) be the sole source of truth with the server acting as a sync target, or should the server be authoritative with local acting as a cache that syncs up when online?
Is this app single-user only (one person per Vrooli server), or should multiple users be able to have their own schemes with optional sharing/collaboration?
For Whisper voice transcription, should it run locally via a Vrooli resource (e.g., whisper.cpp or faster-whisper), or use an external API (e.g., OpenAI Whisper API), or both with fallback?
items.freeform: Use the same approach adopted by the web-console scenario

items.topic: What is the MVP scope? Should v1 include all five toolbar features (mic, plus, graph, agent chat, export), or should some be deferred? For example, agent chat and export require agent-manager integration which adds significant complexity.

options.label: All five toolbar features in v1
Core only (mic, plus, graph toggle) — defer agent chat and export
Core plus agent chat — defer export

items.topic: How should the canvas handle large schemes with 100+ information items? Should there be viewport-based rendering (virtualization), pagination/lazy-loading, or is a simpler approach acceptable for the expected scale?

options.label: Simple DOM rendering (acceptable if schemes stay under ~200 items)
Hierarchical grouping to manage visual complexity

items.topic: For the passive thought suggestions (ghost nodes), what should trigger LLM suggestion generation: on every canvas change, on a timer/idle interval, only on explicit user request, or when the agent chat is open?

options.label: On idle (debounced after user stops interacting)
Triggered by significant changes (new information added, thought linked)

items.freeform: Periodic if there are changes and the previous generation is not still going

items.topic: Should the app be delivered as a PWA (installable from browser), a native mobile app (React Native or similar), or a scenario-to-desktop Electron app with mobile browser support?

options.label: React Native mobile + web UI desktop

items.freeform: Same approach as other apps like web-console. To ensure that it’ll be portable to mobile , make sure to avoid postgres and other non-portable databases as explained in scenarios/prompt-manager/store/skills/packs/core/storage-steer/SKILL.md
